entities.summary: Emmanuel Adetoyese Badejo is a Nigerian Roman Catholic prelate who is serving as the Bishop of Oyo Diocese. Badejo was ordained a priest by Julius Babatunde Adelakun on 4 January 1986 and was appointed the Bishop of Oyo Diocese by Pope Benedict XVI after Adelakun's retirement on 14 August 2007.
